comparison.objective: Exchange charged and depleted mobile-robot battery packs between a bay and charger, not commission an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Pack extraction, handoff, transport, and aligned placement; no setscrew unlocking, fine tuning, or performance cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Charged pack is within 1 cm of the bay and depleted pack within 2.5 cm of the charger, with partial credit for one half.
comparison.reason: Tests ordered component exchange and placement rather than mechanism calibration.
